main_text.l: Varia Scytharum regna fuerunt: Præcipua autem Getarum, Tauricanorum, Amazonum, Sacarum, Massagetarum vel Neurorum, Agathyrsorum, Gelonorum, Budinorum, Sarmatarum & Celtarum: Sed hæc omnia parum nobis cognita sunt. Celeberrimi inter Scythas fuere Europæi ad Danubium atq; Tanaim, & Asiatici sive Massagetæ, quorum Regina fuit Tomyris, quæ Cyrum in prælio obtruncavit.

Inter omnes autem Scytharum res antiquas memorabilis imprimis est ipsorum expeditio Asiatica, quâ Rege Madye sive Indathyrso ingenti cum exercitu universam penè Asiam, usq; ad Ægyptum, Imperio suo subjecerunt, & per 28. annos obtinuerunt; de quo Herodotus lib. 1. & 4.

page.notes: Right margin notes read as "Scythæ / varia re- / gna ha- / buerunt" and "Univer- / sam penè Asiā / sibi subjece- / runt"; the second note is shown here in full as one note beside the second paragraph. The Greek-free text has no doubtful readings except: "Massa-getarum" at a line end is printed with a dot or hyphen after "Maffa" and is transcribed with the hyphen [?]; "Tauricanorum" is printed as "Taurica-" / "norum" and is joined with its hyphen. The catchword "Ex-" and signature "A 6" are at the foot right. The heads "Explic. 1." and "Explic. 2." are set as small centred lines and are given level 2. The left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
